answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 3756 Country: India Title: I wish to knw wether videography and photography is permitted during Nikah (2) whethr it is jayaz for a woman to get her video filmed in her bed room (3) the cameraman asks bride to pose during nikah is it jayaz (4) if the bride or bridegroom is busy in making poses and is not paying full attention during nikah and says qubul with absent mind is Nikah Wajib? Question: I wish to knw wether videography and photography is permitted during Nikah (2) whethr it is jayaz for a woman to get her video filmed in her bed room (3) the cameraman asks bride to pose during nikah is it jayaz (4) if the bride or bridegroom is busy in making poses and is not paying full attention during nikah and says qubul with absent mind is Nikah Wajib? Answer ID: 3756 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 478/588=B) (1) No, videography and photography, both are prohibited by Shariah . (2) It is unlawful (3) It is not allowed, rather it is haram. (4) If he accepts nikah on the dictation of the qazi by intention then the nikah will be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
